# Bells Plumbing Utah
> Licensed emergency plumber serving Davis, Weber, Box Elder, and northern Salt Lake County, Utah. Same-day service, upfront flat pricing, 24/7 emergency calls.

## About
Bells Plumbing is a locally owned plumbing company based in Clearfield, Utah. We specialize in sewer repair, hydro jetting, drain cleaning, water heater installation (including tankless), and emergency plumbing across the Wasatch Front.

## Services
- Emergency plumbing (24/7)
- Sewer backup repair and main line repair
- Hydro jetting and drain cleaning
- Sewer camera inspection
- Tankless and traditional water heater installation
- Leak detection and general plumbing repairs

## Service Areas
Davis County (Bountiful, Layton, Kaysville, Farmington, Clearfield, Syracuse, and more), Weber County (Ogden, Roy, and more), Box Elder County, and northern Salt Lake County.

## Hours
Monday–Saturday 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM. Emergency service available 24/7.
